obfuscation_indicators: select high volume supply chain engagements
risk_summary: The excerpt is highly quantified and provides detailed segment, regional, currency, margin, liquidity, and covenant information. Risk is evident from declining sales, ERP-related disruptions, weaker demand, and reliance on refinancing or renewal of the Program, although management emphasizes covenant compliance and available liquidity. Boilerplate and non-GAAP framing modestly reduce transparency but do not dominate the disclosure.
